The objective function includes terms for the magnetic field, coil length, coil-to-coil distance, coil-to-surface distance, curvature, and mean squared curvature. The code should initialize the boundary magnetic surface, create initial coils, define the individual terms of the objective function, and form the total objective function. It should then perform a Taylor test and run the optimization. After the optimization, the code should use the result as the initial guess for a subsequent optimization with reduced penalty for the coil length. Finally, the code should save the optimized coil shapes and currents.
